svg.aria-label: An extension method call is rewritten by the compiler into an ordinary static method call with the object as the first argument
svg.text: public static string AsPounds(this decimal amount) => $"£{amount:0.00}"; }
It looks like decimal suddenly has a new method.
It doesn't. The compiler rewrites the call into a plain static method call.
The word "this" on the first parameter is what allows the dot syntax. price becomes that argument.

g.text: That's why it can't see private members: it's just an outside method that takes the object.
All of LINQ (orders.Where), and every builder.Services.AddXyz() in ASP.NET Core,
